thread.title: Analysts: iPhone X projections ‘still too high,’ another says AAPL headed to $200

author: Anon
title: Analysts: iPhone X projections ‘still too high,’ another says AAPL headed to $200
text:
Home » Analysts: iPhone X projections ‘still too high,’ another says AAPL headed to $200 Analysts: iPhone X projections ‘still too high,’ another says AAPL headed to $200 2 January 2018 Anon 
Just a week ago, a report came in that Apple would be reducing its iPhone X forecasts from 50M to 30M for Q1, causing a temporary drop in the price of AAPL shares. Now, one analyst believes that not only will Apple indeed post results closer to the rumored 30M mark, but is also concerned about iPhone sales across 2018. Conversely, another analyst puts AAPL’s target price at $200 with Apple trading for around $171/share currently. Keep up to date with LMR Apple Support
